tour.welcome: This is a simple and efficient automated testing platform. Let us take 30 seconds to explore the basic layout.
tour.dashboard: Here you can view test case counts and pass rates, and monitor quality in real time.
tour.navigation: Use the sidebar menu to switch between API testing, Web automation, performance testing, and other core modules.
tour.search: Need to find something fast? Click here or use Ctrl+K / Cmd+K to open global search.
tour.step1Desc: An enterprise-grade AI testing platform supporting API testing, Web automation, APP testing, performance benchmarking, and more.
tour.step2Desc: Get a bird's-eye view of all test data: API case count, Web scripts, performance scenarios, recent test runs, and trend charts.
tour.step3Desc: The sidebar contains all test modules: API testing (Workspace/Collections/Environments), Web automation, APP testing, performance testing. Click to expand.
tour.step4Desc: Press Ctrl+K to quickly search anything: test cases, projects, documents, team members. This is your most efficient navigation tool.
tour.step5Desc: The AI assistant in the bottom-right corner can: generate test cases, analyze failures, create performance scenarios, and explain data. Try chatting with it!
tour.step6Desc: Click the sun/moon icon in the header to switch between light and dark themes. The system also follows your OS theme preference.
tour.step7Desc: Configure AI model parameters, appearance, security policies, notification channels, GitHub integration, and more in System Settings.
